Footloose industries are generally light, high-value, low in transport cost and low in pollution, and are not tied to a raw material or fixed location, e.g. diamond cutting, electronics, software and watch-making. They are not heavy polluting, mining-bound or raw-material-bound industries.

Sugar is raw-material-based because cane is weight-losing and perishable. Bakery is market-based (B wrong), iron and steel is raw-material-based, about 4 t of input per tonne (C wrong), and cement is raw-material-based on limestone, not footloose (D wrong).
